en: A black and white postcard depicting a busy port scene with numerous people, boats, and industrial structures. Prominently visible is a large silo building, with cranes and cargo activity in the foreground. The postcard has text in both French and English at the top: '33. SALONIQUE – Le silo du Port. A view of the Sea-Port.' The bottom right corner contains a web address watermark (www.elia.org.gr).
